ops.title: Prevent periodic geometric monorepo pack-index rewrites
ops.description:
Owner: /root/fresh_disk_gap_relief. Root completed the user-authorized removal of periodic pack-index rewrite jobs at 2026-10-31T13:55:11.853288+00:00.

The known job gui/501/com.yasyf.geometric-repack-monorepo ran unconditional multi-pack-index write, repack --batch-size=256m, and expire every30minutes. It was inactive with active count0 before the action. Root disabled and booted out this exact service; both commands exited0, subsequent lookup returned absent, and persistent disabled state was verified. Script/plist originals remain retained. No active process or protected session was signalled.

Evidence: /Users/yasyf/.local/state/host-pressure-recovery/runs/20261026T235128-repeat/fundamental-efficiency/root-disable-geometric-repack-job.json; SHA256 b9691dbe3077a18ce6acae4ac06fb9e9151c2ad5680912253891e46a82446b93. Original script SHA256 88e3e96af0898a50b2b6acaf6a376f4dbd1933bd7b843137b3f325bb927275e6. Existing daily-repack and RepoSync stops are separate retained actions.

Next executable step: bind this retained action to acceptance criteria and close normally after exact task readback. This prevents future scheduled work; it does not establish that the idle job caused current IO, historical pack growth, or any measured current-load reduction. No further launchd action is requested.
